record_title: Exact central codimensions for the transpose superinvolution on M2
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The characteristic-zero identity basis, cocharacters, and codimension sequence for this transpose-superinvolution algebra are prior work of Giambruno--Ioppolo--Martino (2016); the recent Bezerra dos Santos--Reis preprint also gives the full codimension summation and central-polynomial generators. General central and proper-central exponent theory is prior work as well. The novelty claim is restricted to the exact central-binomial closed forms, the central-codimension sequence, the central-layer multiplicities, and the asymptotic one-quarter/three-quarter split. For DOI 10.4153/S0008439525101276 and DOI 10.1007/s00209-025-03689-8, abstracts and indexed descriptions were inspected but complete article text was not, leaving a residual special-case-coverage risk; the 2026 source preprint may also be revised. No independent validation is asserted.
